The conclusion is essentially saying that anything that is not an ingredient of THE LIPSTICK 14 or Eye Design Palette must be an ingredient of Lip Liner (Peach). It does not provide any information about ingredients that are not of THE LIPSTICK 14 or Eye Design Palette.

Therefore, the argument is invalid.
